## Optional Bindings

### Description
You can overwrite any of the default bindings if you want different/additional behaviour in your ContainerModule you can just use the `rebind` function in the same way you'd use the `bind`.

For example if you need to access additional settings from the AdminPanel you can extend the AdminSettings class defined by the engine and rebind your extended version so the game accesses that instead.

This works for Constant items and Factories. Note that when rebinding Factories you should use bind inside it (as per the example below).

### Examples
```ts
    rebind<VueConstructor<Vue>>(Injects.DesktopHTPComponent).toConstantValue(DesktopHowToPlay);
    rebind<() => string>(Injects.AssetQualityGetter).toFunction(() => '0.5');

    rebind(Injects.AdminSettingsFactory).toFactory(() => {
        return async () => {
            const adminSettings = AdminSettingsEx.Instance;
            await adminSettings.initialise();
            bind(Injects.AdminSettings).toConstantValue(adminSettings);
        };
    });
```

#### Full List:
- ApplicationVue<VueConstructor<Vue>> - The root vue
- DesktopHtp<VueConstructor<Vue>>
- GameVue<VueConstructor<Vue>>
- FrameConnection<implements IFrameConnection>
- Endpoints<implements IEndpoints>
- CurrencySettings<{ ...ICurrencySettings, roundOnWholeUnits: boolean }>
- GameServer<implements IGameServer>
- Stake<implements IStake>
- UserPrefGameName<string>
- SettingsPageGameName<string>
- AssetQualityGetter<() => string>
- AdminSettingsFactory > AdminSettings<IAdminSettings>
- StringsFactory > Strings<implements IStrings> & ErrorStrings<implements ILooseObject>
- SettingsConfigFactory > SettingsConfig<IAdditionalSettingsItem[]>
- ChatRulesFactory > ChatRules<VueConstructor<Vue>> - We have a default instance of this in the Settings package so if not injected this will be null
- BigWin<implements IBigWin> - If not injected no BigWin popup will be shown when the game ends
